dogecoin.text:
Digital skies vast,
Dogecoin jest and surprise,
Value's rise, mirth's guise.

#minimalism #fleetingmoment #nature

Moon's soft glow above,
Dogecoin dances freely,
Market's ebb and flow.

With spirit untamed,
Dogecoin travels through time,
Bringing hope and joy.

Coin of the people,
Fame shining bright like the stars,
In this world of love.
